status: Primary-source method review; diagnostic adaptation, not reproduction or validation of a complete pastoral model

sources.title: FAO (2012), Conducting national feed assessments, Coughenour and Makkar, Animal Production and Health Manual 15
sources.use: Feed supply/demand inventories; seasonal resources and water proximity. Chapter 16 differentiates cattle from other animals and cautions that forage accessibility requires known water locations. We map proximity separately because water permanence, wells and herd types are unknown. No universal water-distance exclusion adopted.

sources.title: FAO, Kenya agro-ecological land resources assessment, Technical Annex 5, chapter 7
sources.use: Section 7.4 defines a 250 kg reference TLU with 6.25 kg DM/day maintenance intake and additional production requirements. Here it is only a feed-equivalent unit; no milk/meat or sustainable herd is inferred.

sources.title: Mottet and Assouma (2024), The feed balances sheet: a tool for planning the use of resources and enhancing resilience in tropical grazing livestock
sources.use: Seasonality and separate DM/energy/protein accounting. Sufficient DM can coexist with protein deficits; generic productivity assumptions can create spurious excesses. We publish conditional DM diagnostics, not herd carrying capacity, and do not reproduce its multi-nutrient FBS.

sources.title: Illius and O'Connor (2000), Resource heterogeneity and ungulate population dynamics
sources.use: Abstract-level motivation for seasonal key-resource limitations and spatial heterogeneity. Publisher full text returned 403. No equations or coefficients copied; no claimed implementation of its ungulate model.

new_assumptions: 0/15 C and 50 mm phenology scales reused as transparent scenario proxies, not coefficients validated for grazing plants
Half annual usable DM as constant test demand; 90 demand-days of storage; zero loss as optimistic reference
No herd birth/death, reproduction, body-condition buffer, migration, grazing feedback, labour, water-volume, protein/energy or animal-food conversion
No adding these feed equivalents to existing farming/pastoral/FORGE populations
